title: Two Goals, Four Minutes Apart
coreQuestion: How did the 'Hand of God' and the 'Goal of the Century' happen four minutes apart?

facts.source: Argentina v England (1986 FIFA World Cup)
facts.claim: Argentina played England in a 1986 FIFA World Cup quarter-final at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City.

facts.source: Argentina v England (1986 FIFA World Cup)

facts.source: Argentina v England (1986 FIFA World Cup)

facts.source: Argentina v England (1986 FIFA World Cup)

narration.text: Four minutes. The same player. Two very different goals.
The 1986 World Cup quarter-final. Argentina against England.
Diego Maradona put the first one in with his hand.
It became known as the Hand of God.
Then he dribbled past five England players and scored again.
FIFA later voted it the Goal of the Century. Every goal has a story.
